summary: Implemented only the art-independent Career World geometry foundation: exhaustive typed primitives, the frozen true-isometric projection, deterministic canonical tuple serialization, palette application outside geometry identity, and a pure compositional SVG renderer. Independent review initially found an invalid detail-tier test fixture plus two validator gaps; the fixture and validators were corrected and the same reviewer returned PASS. All F0-owned checks, repository-wide lint, the full build-backed test suite, and the standalone build pass. The Director repaired the unrelated lint gate with one configuration-only exclusion for frozen provenance scripts; that root-owned adjustment is recorded separately below and is not attributed to the F0 worker.

implemented_invariants: The geometry primitive discriminant is exactly surface, extrusion, or stroke; runtime validation rejects an unknown fourth kind.
Extrusions require a positive finite height, at least three unique finite plan points, and nonzero signed area before SVG projection.
The projection record exactly freezes azimuth 225, look direction 45, elevation 35.264, roll 0, authored rotation false, and the accepted screen formulas.
Generated projection coordinates use deterministic four-decimal formatting and reject nonfinite input or overflow.
The canonical payload is one explicit ordered JSON tuple and excludes palette values, employer ownership, placement, focus, LOD visibility, source-panel metadata, and labels.
All five employer palettes plus world-neutral and ambient-neutral fill the exact eight canonical slots.
The renderer is pure, has explicit data flow, contains no state, effects, image loading, network access, browser measurement, or asset-specific branches.
Every primitive remains in SSR markup with a stable key and tier annotation; detail visibility changes declaratively without changing primitive or primary-path identity.
Tier 0 retains the structural extrusion and primary path; test-only tier 1 and tier 2 fixtures are interior decoration.
Palette swaps change only resolved SVG colors and do not enter canonical geometry identity.

forbidden_scope_audit.note: The two synthetic geometry objects exist only inside unit tests as deterministic serializer and renderer fixtures; they are not exported, registered, placed, or presented as canonical Career World assets.

initial_findings: The renderer test incorrectly hid a structural extrusion at tier 0.
The standalone primitive validator accepted an unknown discriminant.
corrections: Moved the structural extrusion to tier 0, made higher tiers interior-only, and asserted identity continuity across tiers 0, 1, and 2.
Added duplicate-point and zero-area plan rejection and enforced validation inside projectExtrusion.
Added unknown primitive rejection and JavaScript regression coverage.
